MODIS.note: H1 FY27 revenue +53%, operating profit +63%; several Mumbai redevelopment projects under construction (Signature/Square handover in FY27), new Khar projects at ₹45-50k/sq ft, ~2.4 lakh sq ft unsold stock, debt-free; management expects margins to recover

PANACHE.note: Q2 FY27 revenue +232%, PAT +451%, margins up to 9.6%; new laptop supply orders (Nov 2026); management points to electronics design/manufacturing demand (AI, IoT, networking). No numeric guidance and a low base, so growth will be lumpy

DCI.note: Q2 FY27 revenue +38% but PAT only +23% and margins falling; finance cost up 2.7x; ~₹35 cr operating cash outflow in H1 (working capital); no growth guidance - services pivot still early

GCSL.note: Q2 FY27 consolidated profit down ~45% YoY with margin pressure; merchant banking depends on the IPO market; recent SEBI adjudication order and ASM surveillance

GLOBAL.note: Q1 FY27 revenue -5% and profit -11% YoY (flat business); no growth outlook from management

RAPIDFLEET.note: Q1 FY27 revenue +63%; ~₹230 cr new orders for FY27 (₹53 cr renewable-energy logistics); fleet expanded past 300 vehicles (₹12 cr capex)

PTCIL.note: Q1 FY27 revenue +97%, PAT +466%, EBITDA margin ~25%; Airbus titanium castings supply deal (Aug 2026), BrahMos ₹110 cr order, artillery orders; ₹1,800 cr QIP for capacity

544383.note: Management guides FY27 revenue ~₹546 cr (about +30% on FY26 guidance ₹420 cr), order book rising, EBITDA margin up to ~16%, new ports (Haldia, Vizag) - latest half-year numbers not yet verified

544529.note: FY26 revenue +90%, PAT +49%, BUT auditors flagged uncertainty about the company continuing as a going concern - too risky to count on

SAAKSHI.note: Uneven: FY25 revenue -24%, FY26 +25%, H2 FY26 revenue -6%; no clear growth guidance found

SHANTIGOLD.note: Q2 FY27 revenue ₹750 cr vs ₹430 cr (+74%), Q1 FY27 PAT +47%; strong demand from organised jewellery retail; capacity expansion planned

DEEPA.note: Q2 FY27 revenue +25%, PAT +37%; management guides 40-45% CAGR for FY27-FY29; new Hyderabad plant (Sep 2026), Chennai office by Dec

530741.note: Q2 FY27 profit fell sharply; margins very volatile and FY26 profit leaned on other income (~39% of PBT)

SHREEOSFM.note: Q4 FY26 profit -50%; management's own base case is only ~11-12% growth (revenue ~₹160 cr vs ₹153 cr TTM)

KILITCH.note: Q1 FY27 revenue +4% and PAT -13% YoY; no growth outlook found

AEROENTER.note: Q2 FY27 revenue +45%, PAT +87%; subsidiary Aeroflex Industries guides 30-35% growth for FY27 and is adding capacity (₹202 cr) incl. AI data-centre cooling skids

544755.note: FY26 revenue +67%, PAT +261%; management targets ~50% growth in 2027 and similar CAGR for 3 years, margins kept near 20% (extra profit reinvested in brand)

544335.note: FY26 revenue +60%, PAT +78%; order book ₹1,721 cr (31 Aug 2026), up 40% since March with ₹926 cr new wins - about 2 years of revenue

543963.note: FY26 revenue +44%, PAT +25%; 'Vision 2030' target ₹200 cr revenue (~2.7x), second Gujarat plant planned. Caution: margins fell and shares were diluted

AEROPLANE.note: Q2 FY27 revenue +17%, profit +26%; H1 profit ₹78 cr vs ₹49 cr (+60%); loans reduced. Caution: receivables and inventory rising fast (working-capital heavy rice business)

500220.note: Q2 FY27 revenue +64% but PAT -72% (₹0.58 cr) and operating profit halved - profit momentum broken

HIRECT.note: Q1 FY27 revenue +24% but net profit -26% and margin down to 3.5%; no clear guidance

ASHWINI.note: FY26 revenue +37%, PAT +22%; fleet growing (266 -> ~400 vehicles), new 4-year ₹60 cr JNPT port-terminal contract
